at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary values with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0004.title: Guard mutations on invoice.status == draft
at-0004.content: Before mutating an invoice, check invoice.status != "draft" and raise BillingError("invalid_state", ...) with the invoice id and status, matching issue_invoice.

at-0005.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
at-0005.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).

at-0006.title: Period math uses timedelta floor division
at-0006.content: Compute billing period boundaries as `start + ((at - start) // timedelta(days=sub.period_days)) * length`, mirroring `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`.

at-0007.title: Money-moving operations need idempotency_key
at-0007.content: Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. refund in ledgerly/adjustments.py) must accept keyword-only idempotency_key=None, check ledgerly.audit.events() for an existing entry with that key first and return the original result without reapplying, and include idempotency_key in the audit entry. Introduced after double-refund incident INC-204.
